name: 71° North - Norways Toughest Celebrity
description: Ten Norwegian celebrities are pushed far outside the comfort zone and sent on an adventure they have never experienced before. A relentless race from Lindesnes to Nordkapp where they face major challenges.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Ten celebrities replace the red carpet with a black trail, when they already on the first stage get to experience the tenderloin of Norwegian nature. How do they cope with life on tour?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The celebrities fight their way up the majestic Big Brekketind in Stranda. A climb that balances between heaven and hell, magnificently beautiful nature and for some, their greatest phobia: heights. Will the whole team reach the top or will the challenge be too great for some? And where is the host, Tom Stiansen? The team that loses the stage must enter a competition where the loser is marked.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The first stage was difficult for several of the participants. Does everyone have the will to continue north or the journey ends in Stranda? On the next stage, the participants get to work on a slightly different task - they will catch the most beautiful snapshots in beautiful Geiranger, but first they will have a quiet evening around the fire.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: There will be a close race between the teams when the winner of stage two is to be chosen. The participants are in beautiful Geiranger, where they fight against each other divided into teams. The Old Norse will be honoured when they have to recreate three iconic images from the area during the stage. The losing team must enter the season's first brand competition.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: What happens when the team splits and the participants are put to individual trials? With a high tempo and communication over communication, the teams will compete against each other in beautiful Flatanger. A challenge awaits the highest point of the stage, something not all participants are equally excited about.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The participants are soon halfway on the stage in Flatanger. Several of them face their greatest fears when the stage's challenges are implemented. Which team comes to camp first and gets the opportunity to take the lead on the second day of the stage? It is about precise orientation and the right tactics when the last part of the stage takes place in the wet element.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: With a wetsuit and swimming cap, the teams are fighting for victory on the third stage of the season. Which team has chosen the best tactics and can they find all the posts? We move north to Brønnøy where the participants will go on new adventures, but before that the losing team will go out in competition to decide who will be the second brand of the season.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The participants are in the majestic Lomsdal-Visten National Park, where the teams struggle to get to camp first on the first day of the stage. Tour life begins to erode the participants and team morale is put to the test.
